---
title: "Thatcher in Polish"
---

**MA thesis:** *Thatcher in Polish: Translation of Political Conceptual Metaphors in The Downing Street Years*.

This study compares political conceptual metaphors in Margaret Thatcher's English-language memoir and its Polish translation, combining conceptual metaphor theory, corpus-assisted analysis, and translation studies.

**Methods and tools:** corpus alignment, metaphor analysis, FrameBERT, Bertalign.
